children: Photronics reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $216.05M and diluted EPS of $0.49, compared with $210.39M and $0.39 in the prior-year quarter, as net income rose to $28.92M from $22.89M a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Revenue [1]”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Photronics, Inc. shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share attributable to Photronics, Inc. shareholders”.
Revenue growth of roughly 2.8% year-to-date was driven by strong demand in high-end IC photomasks and modest gains in FPD products.
Shipments strengthened to Taiwan, the U.S. and South Korea; China was higher year-to-date but down sequentially.
The company gained share in high-end IC photomasks tied to node migration at 28nm and below.
Gross margin remained around 33% despite materials and labor cost pressures; management is pursuing efficiency programs.
Capex guidance for FY26 is $255M–$305M to expand high-end/mainstream capacity and replace end-of-life equipment.
